label: after
method: Native Playwright mouse, keyboard, and select actions in fresh Chromium contexts. Fixture seeding only through isolated localStorage; application internals are never assigned. Persisted states compared with exact engine transitions.
limitations: Synthetic targeted states are not natural-play or drop-frequency samples.
Geometry records DOM Range and control rectangles, not actual glyph ink. Scroll-clipped content is recorded separately from non-scroll clipping.
Overlap and clipping candidates require visual review; the driver does not silently relabel them as passed.
No performance, FPS or physical-GPU claims are made by this script.
